design.credentials: none; public HTTPS GET only; no model weight downloads
design.cohort: 8 predetermined airports x4 predetermined origins; no replacements based on missingness or outcomes
design.sampling_unit: station, n<=8; four origins remain dependent, not32 independent samples
design.chronology: Exact HF revision commit timestamp before2026-10-01 AND model.safetensors LFS SHA256 at that revision equals cached bytes. No cached mtime inference.
design.scope: Temporal observation holdout only; no new-location or unseen-temperature-distribution claim. Cached Monash pretraining overlap remains unknown.
design.access: One official station-year2026 Parquet per fixed airport, selected columns only on reading; crop October locally. HEAD total before GET; cumulative all-stage body bytes<=40,000,000.
design.quality: temperature is degrees Celsius at tenths precision (no divide-by10). Accept only finite values with blank/null temperature_Quality_Code (no GHCNh flags); reject any nonblank quality code. Missing stays missing.
design.aggregation: UTC left-closed hour bins[h,h+1); average distinct accepted temperatures at each exact timestamp, then average timestamps within hour; all history timestamps strictly before origin.
design.history_missing: At most2 missing hourly bins total per128h history; forward-fill only from preceding observed bins within context. Leading missing or>2 missing makes history ineligible. No backward/interpolated/future fill.
design.future_missing: No future imputation. Preserve every scheduled origin and missing mask; score only complete32h futures, report excluded origins/stations. Do not replace them. History eligibility is independent of future completeness.
methods: fixed depth1 selective tones + native residual median
design.hybrid: Reuse frozen selective_tree.decompose(depth=1), stability>=.65,energy>=.15,prominence>=8,continuous frequencies2..48/128; continuation on horizon32; abstention exactly native; no veto/refit/new tuning or forecast selection.
design.metrics: Future squared error in Celsius^2 and divided by history variance; station averages across complete fixed origins, then equally weight stations. Missingness counts and actual station n always reported.
caveats: Archived quality control may be retrospective; this is not a real-time data-vintage test.
Post-checkpoint dates do not imply unfamiliar geography, climate, seasonality, or distribution.
design.next_decision: First verify public accessibility, station IDs, exact checkpoint chronology and eligible-window counts; then wait for native slot grant.
design.source_change: Legacy ISD discontinued; authorized user amendment to official replacement. Same8 airports, origins, forecast recipes; no outcome-driven station/date choice.
design.station_mapping: Official GHCNh documentation: USW station last5 digits equal WBAN. Exact registry IDs plus coordinates within.01 degrees of the verified ISD ICAO station.

controls: Outcome-blind successor amendment, unchanged airports/dates/methods, verified cached-weight chronology, global40MB limit; 3 focused tests,8 isolated in-memory plants,independent32-window raw-data replay,exact history identity after deleting all future observations. Source/native code and prior studies unchanged.
limitations: Archived quality control may be retrospective; this is not a real-time data-vintage test.
Post-checkpoint dates do not imply unfamiliar geography, climate, seasonality, or distribution.
QC blank means unflagged, not proof of perfect quality; retrospective QC remains a limitation.
Native forecasts are medians, not means; MSE comparison cannot attribute a training prior.
Every October temperature Quality_Code is null in these files. This establishes unflagged status only, not whether QC has run; no claim all temperatures passed QC.
Thirty complete futures are unevenly distributed: JFK two, all other stations four. Equally weight station means; n=8, not30.
evidence_class: observational data availability and provenance; no model performance evidence
next_decision: Wait for native slot grant; unchanged fixed depth1 hybrid versus native medians and seasonal24. No expansion.
